name: Sections
use: Use to narrow a list by facets that each need a title: a range, a segmented row.
notUse: Not for tags that change by job (use FilterChips) or fixed views (use Segment)

name: Fields
use: Use to narrow a list by a few pick-one fields that carry their own labels.
notUse: Not for a range or a segmented row with a help line (use Sections)
